description: Spatial clustering test: are the published McpB sites Q371/E630/E637 a 3D cluster like the Tsr adaptation sites, and where does the structural column set sit
code:
import numpy as np, requests, re, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def read_ca(path):
    out={}
    for l in open(path):
        if not l.startswith("ATOM") or l[12:16].strip()!="CA" or l[16] not in (" ","A"): continue
        out[int(l[22:26])]=np.array([float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])])
    return out
AF={"Tsr":read_ca("tsr_af.pdb"),"McpB":read_ca("mcpB_af.pdb"),"McpC":read_ca("mcpC_af.pdb")}
S={k:"".join(requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.fasta",timeout=30).text.strip().split("\n")[1:])
   for k,a in {"Tsr":"P02942","McpB":"P39215","McpC":"P54576"}.items()}

sets={"Tsr demonstrated sites":("Tsr",[297,304,311,493,502]),
      "McpB published sites (Zimmer 2000, E. coli consensus)":("McpB",[371,595,630,637]),
      "McpB structural columns (this work)":("McpB",[413,420,427,609,618]),
      "McpC structural columns + Q609":("McpC",[407,414,421,603,612,609])}
print("Pairwise CA-CA distances (Angstrom) within each candidate adaptation set\n")
store={}
for name,(k,ps) in sets.items():
    ps=[p for p in ps if p in AF[k]]
    D=np.array([[np.linalg.norm(AF[k][a]-AF[k][b]) for b in ps] for a in ps])
    lab=[f"{S[k][p-1]}{p}" for p in ps]
    off=D[np.triu_indices(len(ps),1)]
    store[name]=(lab,D)
    print(f"{name}:  n={len(ps)}, median pairwise {np.median(off):.1f} A, max {off.max():.1f} A")
    print(pd.DataFrame(np.round(D,1),index=lab,columns=lab).to_string(),"\n")

# how far is McpB Q371 from the published partner sites and from the structural columns?
b=AF["McpB"]
print("McpB Q371 CA distances:",
      {f"{S['McpB'][p-1]}{p}": round(float(np.linalg.norm(b[371]-b[p])),1) for p in [420,427,595,609,618,630,637]})
print("McpB Q420 CA distances:",
      {f"{S['McpB'][p-1]}{p}": round(float(np.linalg.norm(b[420]-b[p])),1) for p in [371,427,595,609,618,630,637]})
print("\nTsr reference, spread of its own five sites: max pairwise",
      round(float(np.max(store['Tsr demonstrated sites'][1])),1),"A")

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,4,figsize=(18,4.4))
for ax,(name,(lab,D)) in zip(axes,store.items()):
    im=ax.imshow(D,cmap="viridis_r",vmin=0,vmax=60)
    ax.set_xticks(range(len(lab))); ax.set_xticklabels(lab,rotation=90,fontsize=8)
    ax.set_yticks(range(len(lab))); ax.set_yticklabels(lab,fontsize=8)
    for i in range(len(lab)):
        for j in range(len(lab)): ax.text(j,i,int(round(D[i,j])),ha="center",va="center",fontsize=7,color="w")
    ax.set_title(name.replace(" (","\n("),fontsize=9)
fig.colorbar(im,ax=axes,shrink=0.8,label="CA-CA distance (A)")
fig.suptitle("Spatial clustering of candidate adaptation sites in the AlphaFold cytoplasmic domains")
plt.show()
